title: Bruce E. Tabashnik: Fighting Insect Resistance
content: Bruce E. Tabashnik is an internationally renowned entomologist whose pioneering research has shaped modern pest management and advanced understanding of insect resistance to Bacillus thuringiensis (Bt) crops and pesticides. After earning a B.S. (1975) in Zoology with High Honors and High Distinction from the University of Michigan, he completed his Ph.D. (1981) in Biological Sciences at Stanford University, supported by fellowships from the National Science Foundation (NSF) and National Institutes of Health (NIH).
